# BaseScript

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("BaseScript")`
- **Abstract**: it exists to be inherited from

The abstract base of anything that carries Luau code. Its source is a PROPERTY, so a script is an ordinary instance: it is created like any other, it lives wherever you put it, and it is saved inside whatever holds it.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Source` | `string` | `""` | read/write | The Luau this instance carries. It is data on the instance rather than a path to a file, which is what makes a script something you can create, copy, put inside a prefab and save in a scene like anything else. |
